title: Expense Reimbursement Request Form
subtitle: Use this request to route the need, test readiness, document review, authorize a bounded action, and verify implementation for a expense reimbursement workflow.
description: An original operational expense reimbursement request form that controls a employee business-expense claim and substantiation record from identity and routing through evidence, qualified decision, exception management, implementation, handoff, and final verification.
use_case: Use when the employee claimant, manager, or expense processor needs a traceable request so the authorized manager, finance, payroll, tax, or compliance reviewer can reimburse, partially reimburse, return, deny, recode, offset an advance, or escalate the claim under the current expense policy, approval limits, receipt and substantiation rules, project coding, and applicable tax requirements without relying on an informal email, spreadsheet, or unreviewed narrative.

sections.title: Expense Reimbursement request identity and routing
sections.guidance: Open one traceable request and identify the responsible reviewers before work begins.

blocks.label: Requested outcome, initiating event, business need, affected people or work, and explicit exclusions

sections.title: Requested expense reimbursement scope and operating need
sections.guidance: Describe the exact requested action and the evidence needed to evaluate it.

blocks.label: Expense Reimbursement request type
items: Travel transportation, lodging, or ground transit
Business meal with attendee and purpose support
Mileage, parking, toll, or local transportation
Training, conference, membership, or registration fee
Approved supply, tool, communication, or home-office expense
Client, candidate, recruiting, or team expense under policy
Foreign-currency claim with conversion evidence
Missing-receipt, late, exceptional, or disputed claim needing review

blocks.label: Operational reason, intended result, assumptions, dependencies, alternatives, and timing impact

sections.title: Expense Reimbursement readiness, policy, and impact review
sections.guidance: Confirm the request can be reviewed without bypassing privacy, safety, security, or authority controls.

blocks.label: Expense Reimbursement readiness checkpoints
items: Claimant, department, manager, cost center, and payment route are verified
Report period, trip, project, event, and business purpose are complete
Every line has date, merchant, category, amount, currency, and payment method
Receipts and alternate-evidence statements are linked to the correct line
Mileage, attendees, allocation, exchange, and category-specific detail is complete
Corporate card, advance, refund, credit, and prior reimbursement are reconciled
Personal and nonreimbursable portions are excluded
Preapproval, policy limit, late submission, and exception status are documented
Manager confirms business purpose and coding without approving own exception
Finance or tax review is routed where the policy requires it
Approved, reduced, denied, returned, and employee-owed amounts reconcile
Payment reference and retention location are recorded at closeout

blocks.label: Request and authority boundary
blocks.guidance: This request does not itself authorize action. The authorized manager, finance, payroll, tax, or compliance reviewer must apply the current expense policy, approval limits, receipt and substantiation rules, project coding, and applicable tax requirements, resolve exceptions, and record any conditions before implementation.

sections.title: Expense Reimbursement review, alternatives, and decision
sections.guidance: Compare the request to the governing evidence and document why the selected route is appropriate.

blocks.label: Requirement, evidence, finding, and decision matrix
Evidence considered, alternatives rejected, approved limits, exception treatment, and communication plan

sections.title: Approved expense reimbursement implementation and exception handoff
sections.guidance: Translate the decision into owned work without losing a condition or system update.

blocks.label: Approved action, condition, system update, and completion evidence
Implementation and communication controls
items: Business purpose and connection are specific and supported
Every line is substantiated under the applicable policy
Duplicate, personal, refunded, and card-paid amounts are excluded
Advance and excess reimbursement are fully reconciled
Cost center, project, client, grant, and tax coding are valid
Exception approver has authority and no self-approval conflict
Approved total equals the sum of line-item dispositions
Payment and retention owners can complete the authorized outcome

blocks.label: Implementation variance, failed dependency, changed fact, immediate action, and reapproval need

sections.title: Expense Reimbursement request completion and closeout
sections.guidance: Close only when the implemented result, remaining limits, and receiving ownership are verifiable.

blocks.label: Open expense reimbursement action and limitation register
Closeout and recipient handoff confirmations
items: Final decision and effective boundary are recorded
Evidence supporting the outcome is linked and readable
Every unresolved action has an owner and due point
Sensitive information is routed only to the designated restricted record
Affected people and receiving systems received the necessary status
Conditions, limitations, and escalation triggers remain visible
Required payroll, schedule, access, asset, or workflow update is confirmed
Follow-up review or reopen condition has an accountable owner

blocks.label: Final evidence, decision rationale, remaining limitation, communication, and acceptance

fields.label: Authorized Manager, Finance, Payroll, Tax, Or Compliance Reviewer / date
